The garden of ancient olive trees, with: Ennimiro y'emizeyituuni egy'edda, ne Kkanisa Ennene ey'Amawanga Gonna eyazimbibwa ku lwazi Mukama waffe kwe yasabira ng'ali mu nnaku ey'amaanyi.
Saint Peter in Gallicantu, Mount Zion: Mutukuvu Peetero mu Gallicantu, Olusozi Sayuuni
The Church of Saint Peter in Gallicantu: Ekkanisa ya Mutukuvu Peetero mu Gallicantu («enkoko bwe yakookolima») ejjukiza okwegaana kwa Peetero n'ekiro Mukama waffe kye yamala mu kkomera. Abalala bateeka ennyumba ya kabona omukulu okumpi ne Cenacolo.
Church of the Flagellation and Ecce Homo: Ekkanisa y'Okukubibwa n'Olukoba lwa Ecce Homo, Via Dolorosa
The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Ekkubo ly'Omusaalaba litandikira ku Kigo kya Antonia, Abafransisiko gye bakuuma ekkanisa z'Okukubibwa n'ez'Okusalirwa omusango. Abayivu bangi bateeka Piraato mu lubiri lwa Kerode okumpi n'Omulyango gwa Yaffa.
The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Ekkubo ly'Omusaalaba, Ekibuga Ekikadde ekya Yerusaalemi
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Okuva mu Mirembe egy'Omu Makkati, abalamazi basaba Ebifo by'Ekkubo ly'Omusaalaba mu luguudo luno, okuva ku Kigo kya Antonia okutuuka e Kalvario; buli Lwakutaano Abafransisiko bakulembera ekitambo. Ekkubo ddala Mukama waffe lye yayitamu lisinziira ku wa Piraato gye yamusalira omusango.
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Abakristu bawa ekitiibwa ekifo kino okuva ku mirembe egyasooka; Mutukuvu Erena ne Konstantino baazimba ekkanisa ennene ku lwazi lwa Kalvario n'entaana enkalu, era kati Abafransisiko be bakiweereza.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Lukka ayogera ku bbanga lya sitadiyo nkaaga okuva e Yerusaalemi (Luke 24:13). Ebifo bisatu biweebwa ekitiibwa: Emmaus Nicopolis, ekiragiddwa wano; El-Qubeibeh, ekikuumibwa Abafransisiko; ne Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Ekkanisa y'Obukulu bwa Mutukuvu Peetero, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Ekkanisa entono ey'amayinja amaddugavu ku lubalama lw'amazzi, eyazimbibwa okwetooloola olwazi oluyitibwa «Mensa Christi» (Emmeeza ya Kristu), ng'ennono bw'egamba gye yategekera Abatume eky'enkya.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Ekkanisa y'Entaana ya Maria, ekiwonvu kya Kidroni
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Okuva mu kyasa eky'okutaano oba emabega, Eklezia y'e Yerusaalemi ewa ekitiibwa entaana eno wansi w'Olusozi lwa Zeyituuni, okumpi ne Gesusemaane, ng'ekifo Maama wa Katonda we yatwalibwa mu ggulu. Ekigo ky'abamonaki eky'Okwebaka ku lusozi Sayuuni kijjukiza okwebaka kwe; ennono endala egamba nti emyaka gye egisembayo yagimala ne Mutukuvu Yokaana mu Efeso.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Ekkanisa entono ey'Okulinnya mu ggulu, Olusozi lwa Zeyituuni
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Lukka agamba nti yabatwala «okutuuka e Besaniya» (Luke 24:50), ate Ebikolwa by'Abatume bigamba nti baava ku Lusozi lwa Zeyituuni (Acts 1:12). Ekkanisa entono ku ntikko ekuuma ejjinja eriweebwa ekitiibwa ng'eririko ekigere kye ekisembayo.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Malayika Gabulyeri alamusa Embeerera ejjudde ekisa. Bw'addamu nti «kibe nga bw'ogambye», Kigambo afuuka omuntu mu lubuto lwe.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Maria atwala Mukama waffe ewa muganda we Erizabeti. Yokaana abuukabuuka mu lubuto olw'essanyu, Erizabeti amuyita «Nnyina wa Mukama wange», era Maria ayimba Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Mu kibuga kya Dawudi, Mukama waffe azaalibwa Bikira Maria, azingibwa mu bugoye era agalamizibwa mu kyalo ky'ensolo, kubanga tebaafuna kifo mu nnyumba y'abagenyi.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Malayika alangirira «Omulokozi, ye Kristu Mukama», n'eggye ery'omu ggulu liyimba nti «Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda waggulu». Abasumba banguwa okunoonya Omwana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Abagezigezi okuva ebuvanjuba bagoberera emmunyeenye ye, basanga Omwana ne Maria nnyina, era bamuwa zaabu, obubaane n'omugavu.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria ne Yozefu baweerayo Mukama Omwana. Simyoni amusitula mu mikono gye, amuyita «omusana ogw'okutangaaza amawanga», era agamba Maria nti ekitala kirifumita omutima gwe.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Ng'alabuddwa mu kirooto, Mutukuvu Yozefu agolokoka ekiro n'atwala Omwana ne nnyina e Misiri, ewala n'omukono gwa Kerode, okutuukiriza ekigambo nti: «Nayita omwana wange okuva e Misiri» (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Kerode bw'amala okufa, Amaka Amatukuvu gabeera e Nazaleesi, era «omwana n'akula, n'afuna amaanyi, ng'ajjudde amagezi, n'ekisa kya Katonda kyali naye».
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'ebiri, asigala e Yerusaalemi oluvannyuma lwa Paasika. Ku lunaku olw'okusatu, Maria ne Yozefu bamusanga wakati w'abayigiriza: «Temwamanya nti kiŋŋwanidde okubeera mu bya Kitange?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Okumala emyaka nga asatu abeera e Nazaleesi, ng'awulira Maria ne Yozefu, ng'akola omulimu gw'obubazzi, era ng'akula mu magezi, mu buwanvu ne mu kisa mu maaso ga Katonda n'abantu.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Yokaana amubatiza mu Yoludaani. Eggulu libikkuka, Omwoyo Mutukuvu akka ng'ejjiba, era eddoboozi lya Kitaffe ligamba nti: «Ono ye Mwana wange omwagalwa, gwe nsanyukira ennyo.»
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Omwoyo amutwala mu ddungu, gy'asiibira ennaku ana n'ebiro ana, era awangula okukemebwa kwa Sitaani ng'akozesa Ekigambo kya Katonda.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Yokaana amulaga ng'agamba nti: «Laba Omwana gw'Endiga wa Katonda.» Andereya aleeta muganda we Simoni, Yezu gw'atuuma Kefa, kwe kugamba Peetero; Firipo ne Nassanayeri bamugoberera.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Ku kigambo kya Nnyina, «Kyonna ky'anaabagamba mukikole», afuula amazzi omwenge, akabonero ke akasooka, era abayigirizwa be batandika okumukkiriza.
The Wedding Feast at Cana: Yezu yeeraga ku mbaga ey'obugole e Kaana
To Jesus through Mary: Okutuuka eri Yezu nga tuyita mu Maria
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Paasika esooka: obunyiikivu olw'ennyumba ya Kitaawe
He drives the money changers from the Te: Agoba abawaanyisa ssente mu Yeekaalu era ekiro ayigiriza Nikodemo nti omuntu ateekwa okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw'okubiri mu mazzi ne mu Mwoyo. «Katonda bwe yayagala ensi bw'atyo, n'awaayo Omwana we omu yekka.»
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Ng'akooye mu ttuntu, asaba omukazi Omusamaliya amazzi ag'okunywa, n'amuwa amazzi ag'obulamu, «oluzzi lw'amazzi agabuguumirira okutuuka mu bulamu obutaggwaawo». Bangi ab'omu kibuga kye bakkiriza.
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Omukungu wa kabaka okuva e Kafarunawumu amwegayirira ajje. «Genda, omwana wo mulamu.» Mu ssaawa eyo yennyini omwana awona.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Mu ssinaagooga asoma mu kitabo kya Isaaya, «Omwoyo wa Mukama ali ku nze», n'agamba nti: «Leero ekyawandiikibwa kino kituukiridde.» Ab'ewaabwe bamutwala ku mabbali g'olusozi, naye n'abayitamu wakati n'agenda.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Abafransisiko bawa ekitiibwa Olusozi lw'Okubuuka ebukiika ddyo bw'ekibuga ng'olusozi olwogerwako mu Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Bw'ava e Nazaleesi, abeera e Kafarunawumu ku lubalama lw'ennyanja, era atandika okubuulira: «Ekiseera kituuse, Obwakabaka bwa Katonda busembedde. Mwenenye era mukkirize Enjiri.»
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Ku lubalama ayita Simoni ne Andereya, Yakobo ne Yokaana: «Mungoberere, nange ndibafuula abavubi b'abantu.» Oluvannyuma lw'okuvuba okw'ekyamagero, baleka byonna ne bamugoberera.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Ayigiriza n'obuyinza mu ssinaagooga, agoba omwoyo omubi mu muntu, ayimusa nnyazaala wa Peetero mu musujja, era enjuba bw'egwa ekibuga kyonna kikuŋŋaana ku mulyango.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Omulwadde wa lukonvuba n'okuyitibwa kwa Matayo
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Mikwano gy'omulwadde wa lukonvuba bamussa nga bayita mu kasolya; Yezu amusonyiwa ebibi era amulagira okutambula. Oluvannyuma ayita Leevi, ye Matayo, ku kifo ky'omusolo: «Ngoberera.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Ayigiriza Emikisa, «Balina omukisa abaavu mu mwoyo, kubanga obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu bwabwe», etteeka eppya ery'okwagala, n'essaala ya Kitaffe.
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Omwami w'ekitongole Omuruumi agamba nti: «Mukama wange, sisaanira ggwe okuyingira mu nnyumba yange, naye yogera kigambo kyokka.» Eklezia eddamu ebigambo bye nga tennaba kusembera mu buli Mmisa.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Asaasira nnamwandu eyali agenda okuziika omwana we omu yekka, akwata ku kitanda ky'omulambo: «Omulenzi, nkugamba nti golokoka!» era amuddiza nnyina.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Ku mbaga e Yerusaalemi awonya omusajja eyali amaze emyaka amakumi asatu mu munaana ng'alwadde: «Golokoka, situla omukeeka gwo, otambule.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Omuyaga ogw'amaanyi gujjuza eryato amazzi, ng'ye yeebase. Anenya empewo: «Sirika! Teeka!» ne wabaawo okuteeka okungi. «Ono ye ani, n'empewo n'ennyanja okumuwulira?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Emitala w'olubalama awonya omusajja eyali abonyaabonyezebwa emyoyo emibi mingi, egisindikibwa mu kisibo ky'embizzi. Omusajja amwegayirira amugoberere, naye asindikibwa okulangirira Mukama by'amukoledde.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Omukazi awona ng'akutte ku kyambalo kye, era akwata omukono gwa muwala wa Yayiro eyali afudde: «Talisa kumi», kwe kugamba nti: «Muwala, nkugamba nti golokoka!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: N'emigaati etaano n'ebyennyanja bibiri aliisa ekibiina, ng'atunula waggulu mu ggulu, yeebaza era n'amenya emigaati, era ne bakuŋŋaanya ebisero kkumi na bibiri ebijjudde obukunkumuka.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Mu kisisimuka eky'ekiro ajja gye bali ng'atambulira ku nnyanja. Peetero atambula okumusisinkana, atandika okubbira era akaaba nti: «Mukama wange, ndokola!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: Mu ssinaagooga y'e Kafarunawumu ayigiriza: «Nze mugaati ogw'obulamu… Alya omubiri gwange n'anywa omusaayi gwange alina obulamu obutaggwaawo.» Peetero addamu nti: «Mukama wange, tunaagenda eri ani?»
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Maama ow'eggwanga eddala amwegayirira ku lwa muwala we: «N'embwa nazo zirya obukunkumuka obugwa okuva ku mmeeza ya bakama baazo.» «Mukazi, okukkiriza kwo kunene!»
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Aggula amatu g'omusiru-kiggala, «Effasa», kwe kugamba nti «Ggukka!», era n'emigaati musanvu aliisa enkumi nnya abaali bamaze naye ennaku ssatu.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Abafalisaayo n'Abasaddukaayo bamusaba akabonero okuva mu ggulu. Abagamba nti tebaliweebwa kabonero kalala wabula akabonero ka Yona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Akwata muzibe ku mukono, amutwala ebweru w'akabuga, era amussaako emikono emirundi ebiri, okutuusa lw'alaba byonna bulungi.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Naye mmwe mugamba nti nze ani?» Peetero addamu nti: «Ggwe Kristu, Omwana wa Katonda omulamu.» «Ggwe Peetero, era ku lwazi luno ndizimbako Eklezia yange… Ndikuwa ebisumuluzo by'Obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Mu maaso ga Peetero, Yakobo ne Yokaana, amaaso ge gaayaka ng'enjuba, Musa ne Eriya boogera naye, era Kitaffe agamba nti: «Ono ye Mwana wange omwagalwa… Mumuwulirenga.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Anenya ebibuga mwe yakolera ebyamagero bye ebisinga obungi, Kolazini, Besusayida ne Kafarunawumu, kubanga tebeenenya.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Peetero afuna omusolo gwa Yeekaalu mu kamwa k'ekyennyanja. Oluvannyuma Yezu ayimiriza omwana wakati waabwe: «Bwe mutakyuka ne mufaanana ng'abaana abato, temuliyingira mu Bwakabaka obw'omu ggulu.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: Mu mpya za Yeekaalu ayigiriza: «Buli alina ennyonta ajje gye ndi anywe», asonyiwa omukazi eyakwatibwa mu bwenzi, «Genda, era okuva kati tokyayonoona nate», era alangirira nti: «Nze musana gw'ensi.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Asiiga ebitosi ku maaso g'omusajja eyazaalibwa nga muzibe, n'amusindika okunaaba mu kidiba kya Sirowamu. Akomawo ng'alaba era amusinza: «Mukama wange, nzikiriza.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Maliza amusembeza, ate Maria atuula ku bigere bye ng'awuliriza. «Maria yeerondedde omugabo omulungi, era tegulimuggyibwako.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Lukka agamba bugambi nti «mu kabuga akamu»; Yokaana ayogera ku Besaniya ng'amaka ga Maliza ne Maria (John 11:1).
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Omu ku bayigirizwa bw'amusaba okubayigiriza okusaba, abawa essaala ya Kitaffe.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Lukka tayogera kifo; ennono ekijjukirira mu mpuku ya Eleona ku Lusozi lwa Zeyituuni. Matayo awa essaala eyo mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Atambula mu kisasi kya Sulemaani mu biseera by'obutiti, n'agamba nti: «Endiga zange ziwulira eddoboozi lyange… Nze ne Kitange tuli omu.»
Addayo ku kifo Yokaana we yasookera okubatiza. Ayigiriza nti Katonda kye yagatta omuntu takyawulangamu, era awa abaana omukisa: «Mukkirize abaana abato bajje gye ndi.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Nze kuzuukira n'obulamu.» Yezu akaaba ku ntaana ya mukwano gwe, oluvannyuma n'ayogerera waggulu nti: «Lazaalo, fuluma!» era omufu n'afuluma ng'akyasibiddwa mu ngoye.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Olukiiko olukulu bwe lusala amagezi okumutta, yeekweka n'abayigirizwa be mu kibuga okumpi n'eddungu ekiyitibwa Efulayimu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Muzibe Battimaayo akaaba nti: «Yezu, Omwana wa Dawudi, onsaasire!» era n'azibuka amaaso. Zaakayo alinnya omuti gw'omukenene okumulaba: «Leero obulokozi butuuse mu nnyumba eno.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Ennaku mukaaga nga Paasika tennatuuka, Maria afuka ku bigere bye amafuta ag'akaloosa aga naludo ag'omuwendo omungi, ennyumba n'ejjula akaloosa. Akikkiriza ng'okumusiiga amafuta ag'okuziikibwa kwe.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Ayingira e Yerusaalemi ng'atudde ku mwana gw'endogoyi ng'ekibiina kyaliira engoye n'amatabi: «Ozanna eri Omwana wa Dawudi! Yeebazibwe ajja mu linnya lya Mukama!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Bw'alaba ekibuga, akikaabira: «Singa naawe olwa leero wamanya ebikuleetera emirembe!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Avuunika emmeeza, «Ennyumba yange eriyitibwa nnyumba ya kusabiramu eri amawanga gonna», era atendereza nnamwandu omwavu eyawaayo obusente bwe obubiri obusembayo.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Ng'atudde ku Lusozi lwa Zeyituuni okutunuulira Yeekaalu, ayogera ku kuzikirizibwa kwayo ne ku kujja kwe mu kitiibwa: «Kye mwakolera omu ku baganda bange abo abasinga obutono, nze gwe mwakikolera.»
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Anaaza ebigere by'abayigirizwa be era, ng'akutte omugaati n'omwenge, agamba nti: «Kino mubiri gwange… Ekikompe kino ye ndagaano empya mu musaayi gwange… Mukolenga bwe muti okunjijukira»; bw'atyo awa Eklezia Ekisakramentu ky'Ekyusa n'Obusaserdooti.
The Agony in the Garden: Ennaku ennyingi ya Yezu mu nnimiro
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: Mu nnaku ennyingi asaba, n'entuuyo ze ziba ng'amatondo g'omusaayi: «Kitange… si nga nze bwe njagala, wabula nga ggwe bw'oyagala.» Yuda ajja n'ekibiina era amulyamu olukwe ng'amunywegera.
Before Caiaphas; Peter's Denial: Mu maaso ga Kayaafa; okwegaana kwa Peetero
Bound, He is led before Annas and the hi: Ng'asibiddwa, bamutwala ewa Ana n'ewa kabona omukulu Kayaafa, ne bamusalira omusango gw'okuvvoola Katonda. Mu luggya, Peetero amwegaana emirundi esatu; enkoko ekookolima, era Peetero akaaba nnyo.
Pilate finds no guilt in Him and sends H: Piraato talaba musango gw'amusaliza, n'amusindika ewa Kerode, amusekerera n'amuzzaayo. Ekibiina kisaba Baalaba, era Piraato abakkiriza.
\"Then Pilate took Jesus and had him sco: «Awo Piraato n'atwala Yezu, n'amukubisa embooko.» «Olw'ebiwundu bye ffe twawonyezebwa» (Isaiah 53:5).
The soldiers weave a crown of thorns, cl: Abaserikale balanga engule ey'amaggwa, bamwambaza olugoye olwa kakobe ne bamusekerera: «Mirembe, Kabaka w'Abayudaaya!» Piraato amufulumya: «Laba omuntu!» era amuwaayo okukomererwa.
Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Ng'asitudde omusaalaba gwe, afuluma okugenda e Kalvario. Simooni Omukuleeni awalirizibwa okumuyamba, era agamba abakazi abakaaba nti: «Abawala ba Yerusaalemi, temunkaabira nze, naye mwekaabire mwekka n'abaana bammwe.»
He is crucified between two thieves. \"F: Akomererwa wakati w'abazzi b'emisango babiri. «Kitange, basonyiwe, kubanga tebamanyi kye bakola.» «Leero onoobeera nange mu lusuku lwa Katonda.» «Maama, laba omwana wo… Laba nnyoko.» «Kiwedde.» Akutamya omutwe n'awaayo omwoyo.
Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Yusufu ow'e Alimasaya ne Nikodemo bazinga omubiri gwe mu ngoye za kitaani wamu n'ebyakaloosa, ne bamuteeka mu ntaana empya eyasimibwa mu lwazi, mu nnimiro eriraanye ekifo we yakomererwa.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Ku lunaku olusooka mu wiiki, entaana nkalu. Mukama azuukidde ayita Maria Magdalena erinnya lye era amutuma eri Abatume: «Ndabye Mukama.»
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Nga tebamumanyi, atambula n'abayigirizwa babiri era abannyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa, bwe batyo ne bamutegeera ng'amenya omugaati. «Emitima gyaffe tegyayakanga munda yaffe?»
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Enzigi nga nzigale, ayimirira wakati w'Abatume era abassizaako omukka: «Mufune Omwoyo Mutukuvu. Be munaasonyiwanga ebibi, binaabanga bibasonyiyiddwa», era wiiki bw'eggwaako Tomasi ayatula nti: «Mukama wange, era Katonda wange!»
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: Mu makya ku nnyanja ajjuza obutimba bwabwe era abateekerateekera eky'enkya. Abuuza Peetero emirundi esatu nti: «Onjagala?» era emirundi esatu amukwasa nti: «Liisa endiga zange.»
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Ku lusozi mu Ggaliraaya atuma Ekkumi n'Omu: «Kale mugende muyigirize amawanga gonna, nga mubabatiza mu linnya lya Kitaffe, n'Omwana, n'Omwoyo Mutukuvu… Era laba, ndi nammwe ennaku zonna okutuusa ku nkomerero y'ensi.»
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Matayo tayogera linnya lya lusozi. Abalamazi emirundi mingi bakijjukirira ku Lusozi lw'Emikisa; abalala balowooza ku Taboli oba olusozi Arbel.
Forty days after Easter He blesses the a: Ennaku ana oluvannyuma lwa Paasika awa Abatume omukisa, abasuubiza Omwoyo Mutukuvu, era atwalibwa mu ggulu nga balaba; baddayo e Yerusaalemi n'essanyu lingi.
Fifty days after Easter, as the apostles: Ennaku ataano oluvannyuma lwa Paasika, Abatume bwe baali mu kusaba n'omutima gumu wamu ne Maria, Nnyina wa Yezu, Omwoyo Mutukuvu abakkako mu nnimi ez'omuliro. Peetero abuulira Kristu eyakomererwa n'azuukira, abantu nga enkumi ssatu babatizibwa, era Eklezia egenda mu mawanga gonna.
The Assumption of Our Lady: Okutwalibwa mu ggulu kwa Bikira Maria
At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Obulamu bwe obw'oku nsi bwe bwaggwaako, Maama wa Katonda Atasaggulwako Kibi, Bikira Maria bulijjo, yatwalibwa mu kitiibwa eky'omu ggulu omwoyo n'omubiri, nga Paapa Piyo XII bwe yakirangirira mu butongole mu 1950. Eyazaala Mukama gwe musooka okugabana ku kuzuukira kw'Omwana we.
Scripture does not record the place. It: Ebyawandiikibwa tebyogera kifo. Kiragiddwa ku ntaana Eklezia y'e Yerusaalemi gy'ekuzizzaako okuva edda okutwalibwa kwe mu ggulu.
Her Son crowns the Blessed Virgin Queen: Omwana we atikkira Embeerera ey'omukisa nga Kabaka Omukazi ow'eggulu n'ensi, Kabaka Omukazi wa bamalayika n'abatukuvu. «Akabonero akanene ne kalabika mu ggulu: omukazi ayambadde enjuba, omwezi nga guli wansi w'ebigere bye, ne ku mutwe gwe engule ey'emmunyeenye kkumi na bbiri.»
This mystery takes place in heaven; it i: Ekyama kino kibeera mu ggulu; kiragiddwa wano wamu n'okutwalibwa kwe mu ggulu.
The Coronation of Mary: Okutikkirwa kwa Maria nga Kabaka Omukazi ow'eggulu n'ensi
Mondays and Saturdays, and the Sundays o: Bbalaza ne Lwamukaaga, Ssande za Adventi n'ez'ekiseera kya Ssekukkulu
Tuesdays and Fridays, and the Sundays of: Lwakubiri ne Lwakutaano, Ssande za Kiseera kya Lent
The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Ssappule yazaalibwa mu kusaba kw'Eklezia. Abamonaki bayimbanga zabbuli 150, ate Abakristu abataamanya kusoma baasabanga Kitaffe 150, oluvannyuma Mirembe Maria 150, nga bazibala ku muguwa oguliko obuyinja: «Zabbuli za Maria».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Ng'ennono eyagalibwa ennyo bw'egamba, Bikira Maria yawa Ssappule Mutukuvu Dominiko e Prouille mu Bufalansa ku ntandikwa y'ekyasa eky'ekkumi n'essatu, okumuyamba mu kubuulira kwe okulwanyisa obujeemu bw'Abaalubigensi. Ekibiina kye, Ekibiina ky'Ababuulizi, kyagisaasaanya mu Bukristu bwonna, era mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'ettaano Omutukuvu Alano de la Roche, Omudominikani, yazza buggya okwewaayo kuno era n'atandika ebibiina ebyasooka ebya Ssappule.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Mutukuvu Paapa Piyo V, naye Omudominikani, yawa Ssappule enkula yaayo eya bulijjo ey'ebyama kkumi na bitaano, eby'Essanyu, eby'Ennaku n'eby'Ekitiibwa, mu 1569. Oluvannyuma lw'obuwanguzi bwa Lepanto nga 7 Okitobba 1571, obwaweebwa olw'Obukristu bwonna okusaba Ssappule, yafuula olunaku olwo embaga ya Maria ow'Obuwanguzi, kati ekijjukizo kya Bikira Maria ow'Ssappule. E Lourdes ne Fatima, Embeerera yennyini yajja n'essappule era n'esaba eyogerwenga buli lunaku.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Nga 16 Okitobba 2002, Mutukuvu Paapa Yowanne Pawulo II yayongerako ebyama bitaano eby'Ekitangaala, okuva mu bulamu bwa Mukama waffe obw'olwatu, mu bbaluwa ye ey'obutume Rosarium Virginis Mariae, Ssappule esobole okubeera «ensonga enkulu ey'Enjiri». Mu buli kyama tufumiitiriza ku maaso ga Kristu nga tutunula n'amaaso ga Nnyina.
